Dukascopy tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0 (RVOL 0.996), but structure and CVD strongly support immediate continuation.

Price is above VAH 73808.59 and above POC 73660.40 in LONDON_SESSION. CVD is BEARISH (-0.03) showing subtle divergence against price. Structure remains above VWAP 73650.72 and EMA50 73705.04, but price is struggling right at S/R 73975.30 and Session High 74085.20 area under upper ATR band 74188.38.
